title: Installed toast on a CPU Pod offers Restart engine for an engine that does not exist
description: A model installed onto the volume through a download-only (CPU) Pod toasted 'Restart the engine to load it now' with a Restart button. The toast picked the engine from isRemote(), not from the job. The model-level download:complete now carries the job's engine; a Pod install on a download-only Pod toasts just 'installed'. A local install keeps its Restart offer.
